q: 今年冬天特别冷，十月___下雪了。
zh: 今年冬天特别冷，十月就下雪了。
py: jīn nián dōng tiān tè bié lěng shí yuè jiù xià xuě le
en: This winter is especially cold; it had already snowed by October.
why: Snow in October is early, and the sentence ends with 了: 就. 才 would mean 'not until October' and cannot take this 了.

q: 下雨的时候，教室里___有三个人，别的同学都回家了。
zh: 下雨的时候，教室里就有三个人，别的同学都回家了。
py: xià yǔ de shí hou jiào shì lǐ jiù yǒu sān gè rén bié de tóng xué dōu huí jiā le
en: When it rained, only three people were in the classroom; the other students had gone home.
why: 就 before 有 and a small number means 'only', matching 别的同学都回家了. 也 means 'also' and 都 means 'all', both of which contradict the empty room.

q: 天一冷，我___咳嗽。
zh: 天一冷，我就咳嗽。
py: tiān yī lěng wǒ jiù ké sou
en: Whenever it turns cold, I cough.
why: 一冷…就咳嗽 is the 'whenever' pattern: the second action follows at once. 才 reverses it to lateness, and 也 and 再 do not pair with 一.

q: 我一天___睡五个小时，难怪总是感冒。
zh: 我一天就睡五个小时，难怪总是感冒。
py: wǒ yī tiān jiù shuì wǔ gè xiǎo shí nán guài zǒng shì gǎn mào
en: I only sleep five hours a day, no wonder I always catch colds.
why: 就 before a verb and a small amount means 'only', and 难怪总是感冒 confirms it is too little. 也 'also' and 再 'again' do not fit.

s: 这件衣服十块钱才，真便宜。
s_py: zhè jiàn yī fu shí kuài qián cái zhēn pián yi
zh: 这件衣服才十块钱，真便宜。
py: zhè jiàn yī fu cái shí kuài qián zhēn pián yi
en: This piece of clothing is only ten kuai, really cheap.
why: 才 meaning 'only' comes before the price, not after it.

q: 天气预报说下午下雨，可是中午___下起来了。
zh: 天气预报说下午下雨，可是中午就下起来了。
py: tiān qì yù bào shuō xià wǔ xià yǔ kě shì zhōng wǔ jiù xià qǐ lái le
en: The forecast said rain in the afternoon, but it had already started raining at noon.
why: Noon is earlier than the forecast afternoon, and the clause ends in 了: 就. 才 would mean the rain came later than expected, and 才 does not combine with this 了.

q: 你找医生吗？我___是医生。
zh: 你找医生吗？我就是医生。
py: nǐ zhǎo yī shēng ma wǒ jiù shì yī shēng
en: Are you looking for the doctor? I am the doctor.
why: 就是 identifies the very person asked about: 'I'm the one'. 也是 would mean 'I am a doctor too', which does not answer the question.

zh: 他一晒太阳就头疼。
py: tā yī shài tài yáng jiù tóu téng
en: He gets a headache as soon as he is in the sun.
why: 一 and 就 each stand directly before their own verb. The subject 他 can come before 一 or before 就.

q: 医生说他的年纪不大，今年___四十五岁，只要多运动，身体就会好起来。
zh: 医生说他的年纪不大，今年才四十五岁，只要多运动，身体就会好起来。
py: yī shēng shuō tā de nián jì bù dà jīn nián cái sì shí wǔ suì zhǐ yào duō yùn dòng shēn tǐ jiù huì hǎo qǐ lái
en: The doctor said he isn't old, only forty-five this year, and with more exercise his health will improve.
why: 不大 sets up 'only': 才 before the age says forty-five is young. 都 needs 了 and means 'already', 也 means 'also', and neither fits 年纪不大.

s: 全班同学都做完了，就小李还在写。
s_py: quán bān tóng xué dōu zuò wán le jiù xiǎo lǐ hái zài xiě
zh: 全班同学都做完了，就小李还在写。
py: quán bān tóng xué dōu zuò wán le jiù xiǎo lǐ hái zài xiě
en: Everyone in the class has finished; only Xiao Li is still writing.
why: 就 before a person means 'only', so 就小李 is correct even though it stands before the subject of the clause.

q: 我的家人都很健康，___我妈妈有一点咳嗽。
zh: 我的家人都很健康，就我妈妈有一点咳嗽。
py: wǒ de jiā rén dōu hěn jiàn kāng jiù wǒ mā ma yǒu yī diǎn ké sou
en: My family are all healthy; only my mum has a bit of a cough.
why: 就 before a person singles that person out: 'only my mum'. 也 and 都 cannot stand before the subject, and 还 does not add the exclusion needed after 都很健康.

q: 这里___是我们学校的医务室，门上写着呢。
zh: 这里就是我们学校的医务室，门上写着呢。
py: zhè lǐ jiù shì wǒ men xué xiào de yī wù shì mén shàng xiě zhe ne
en: This is our school's clinic, it says so on the door.
why: 就是 identifies the place exactly: 'this very spot is the clinic'. 也是 would say 'also', but no other clinic has been mentioned.

s: 现在七点才，你再睡一下吧。
s_py: xiàn zài qī diǎn cái nǐ zài shuì yī xià ba
zh: 现在才七点，你再睡一下吧。
py: xiàn zài cái qī diǎn nǐ zài shuì yī xià ba
en: It's only seven o'clock; sleep a little longer.
why: 才 for 'only' stands before the time, never after it: 才七点.

q: 下大雪那天，爸爸五点就起床___，妈妈七点才起床___。
zh: 下大雪那天，爸爸五点就起床了，妈妈七点才起床。
py: xià dà xuě nà tiān bà ba wǔ diǎn jiù qǐ chuáng le mā ma qī diǎn cái qǐ chuáng
en: On the day of the heavy snow, Dad got up as early as five, and Mom didn't get up until seven.
why: The 就 clause is a finished early event and takes 了; the 才 'not until' clause takes none. 了|了 is the tempting answer because both events are past.

s: 你不吃药，我就不让你去学校。
s_py: nǐ bù chī yào wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ qù xué xiào
zh: 你不吃药，我就不让你去学校。
py: nǐ bù chī yào wǒ jiù bù ràng nǐ qù xué xiào
en: If you don't take your medicine, I won't let you go to school.
why: 就 follows the subject 我 and stands before 不让. This is the right place for 'then'.

s: 你要找的医生是就我。
s_py: nǐ yào zhǎo de yī shēng shì jiù wǒ
zh: 你要找的医生就是我。
py: nǐ yào zhǎo de yī shēng jiù shì wǒ
en: The doctor you're looking for is me.
why: 就 goes before 是 in the emphatic 就是, never after it.

q: 刚才出了一身汗，我换了衣服，没过十分钟就感冒___。
zh: 刚才出了一身汗，我换了衣服，没过十分钟就感冒了。
py: gāng cái chū le yī shēn hàn wǒ huàn le yī fu méi guò shí fēn zhōng jiù gǎn mào le
en: I had just sweated a lot, changed my clothes, and caught a cold within ten minutes.
why: A single finished event with 就 needs 了. 没过十分钟 shows it happened quickly, which is the 就 reading; dropping 了 would leave the sentence unfinished.

s: 我有就十块钱，买不了药。
s_py: wǒ yǒu jiù shí kuài qián mǎi bù liǎo yào
zh: 我就有十块钱，买不了药。
py: wǒ jiù yǒu shí kuài qián mǎi bù liǎo yào
en: I only have ten kuai, so I can't buy the medicine.
why: 就 is an adverb and goes before the verb 有, not after it: 就有十块钱.

q: 你问药店在哪儿？你看，药店___在医院旁边。
zh: 你问药店在哪儿？你看，药店就在医院旁边。
py: nǐ wèn yào diàn zài nǎ r nǐ kàn yào diàn jiù zài yī yuàn páng biān
en: You're asking where the pharmacy is? Look, it's right next to the hospital.
why: 就在 points to the place precisely: 'right next to'. 也 would mean the pharmacy is also there, but nothing else has been mentioned.

q: 我家___在公园对面，走路两分钟。
zh: 我家就在公园对面，走路两分钟。
py: wǒ jiā jiù zài gōng yuán duì miàn zǒu lù liǎng fēn zhōng
en: My home is right opposite the park, a two-minute walk.
why: 就在 means 'right at' and agrees with 两分钟. 也在 would mean 'also at', and 都在 would mean 'all at', neither fitting a single home.

q: ___你不舒服，___要去看医生。
zh: 只要你不舒服，就要去看医生。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ bù shū fu jiù yào qù kàn yī shēng
en: As long as you feel unwell, you should see a doctor.
why: 'As long as' is 只要, and the easy result is answered by 就. 只有…才 would mean 'only if', and mixing the pairs (只要…才, 只有…就) is the classic error.

s: 雨停了，才我们能出门。
s_py: yǔ tíng le cái wǒ men néng chū mén
zh: 雨停了，我们才能出门。
py: yǔ tíng le wǒ men cái néng chū mén
en: We can only go out once the rain has stopped.
why: 才 is an adverb: it follows the subject and comes before the modal 能. It never starts a clause the way English 'only then' does.

q: 你感冒还没好，医生说你得再休息三天才能上班___。
zh: 你感冒还没好，医生说你得再休息三天才能上班。
py: nǐ gǎn mào hái méi hǎo yī shēng shuō nǐ děi zài xiū xi sān tiān cái néng shàng bān
en: You haven't recovered from your cold yet; the doctor says you must rest three more days before you can go to work.
why: This is a future condition with 才, and 才 never takes 了. A final 了 would wrongly turn it into a finished event.

q: 如果明天不下雨，我们___去爬山。
zh: 如果明天不下雨，我们就去爬山。
py: rú guǒ míng tiān bù xià yǔ wǒ men jiù qù pá shān
en: If it doesn't rain tomorrow, we'll go hiking.
why: 如果 pairs with 就 in the second clause, right after the subject. 才 would turn the condition into 'only if', and 再 or 也 do not answer 如果.

q: 他昨天吃了药，一个小时就退烧___。
zh: 他昨天吃了药，一个小时就退烧了。
py: tā zuó tiān chī le yào yī gè xiǎo shí jiù tuì shāo le
en: He took the medicine yesterday and his fever was down within an hour.
why: 就 with a single finished event in the past takes 了. 才 would be the pattern with no 了, but 一个小时 is quick, so 就…了 is the pairing.

q: ___坚持锻炼，身体___会越来越好。
zh: 只有坚持锻炼，身体才会越来越好。
py: zhǐ yǒu jiān chí duàn liàn shēn tǐ cái huì yuè lái yuè hǎo
en: Only by keeping up regular exercise will your health get better and better.
why: 'Only by' is 只有, answered by 才. 只要…就 would mean 'as long as', which loses the single necessary condition in the English cue.

q: 体检的结果很快，半个小时___出来了。
zh: 体检的结果很快，半个小时就出来了。
py: tǐ jiǎn de jié guǒ hěn kuài bàn gè xiǎo shí jiù chū lái le
en: The check-up results are quick: they came out in just half an hour.
why: 很快 and a short half hour make 就 the right word, with 了 at the end. 才 would suggest the results were slow.

q: 我一喝冷水___肚子疼。
zh: 我一喝冷水就肚子疼。
py: wǒ yī hē lěng shuǐ jiù dù zi téng
en: I get a stomach ache as soon as I drink cold water.
why: 一 + action + 就 + result means 'as soon as / whenever'. 才 is the opposite idea of lateness, and 也 and 再 cannot complete 一.

src_py: tā hē lěng shuǐ dù zi téng
task: Say he gets it whenever he drinks, using 一…就.
zh: 他一喝冷水就肚子疼。
py: tā yī hē lěng shuǐ jiù dù zi téng
en: He gets a stomach ache as soon as he drinks cold water.
why: 一 and 就 each go right before their own verb. 他 can also come before 就 instead of before 一.

q: 现在___九月，天气还很热，不用穿外套。
zh: 现在才九月，天气还很热，不用穿外套。
py: xiàn zài cái jiǔ yuè tiān qì hái hěn rè bù yòng chuān wài tào
en: It's only September, the weather is still hot, and you don't need a coat.
why: 才 before a month means 'only, still early', matching 还很热. 已经 would imply a late date and is normally followed by 了.

q: ___你多喝水、多休息，感冒___会好得更快。
zh: 只要你多喝水、多休息，感冒就会好得更快。
py: zhǐ yào nǐ duō hē shuǐ duō xiū xi gǎn mào jiù huì hǎo de gèng kuài
en: As long as you drink plenty of water and rest, your cold will get better faster.
why: 'As long as' is 只要 with 就. 只有|才 would turn the advice into a single necessary condition, and 只要…才 and 如果…才 mismatch the pair.

q: 你要先把汗擦干，换上干衣服，我们___能出门，不然会着凉。
zh: 你要先把汗擦干，换上干衣服，我们才能出门，不然会着凉。
py: nǐ yào xiān bǎ hàn cā gān huàn shàng gān yī fu wǒ men cái néng chū mén bù rán huì zháo liáng
en: You have to wipe off the sweat and change into dry clothes first; we can't go out until then, or you'll catch a chill.
why: 先…才能 means we cannot go out until the conditions are met, so 才 comes right before 能. 就 would say going out is easy, which clashes with 不然会着凉.

q: 医生一看我的嗓子，___说我是上火了，让我多喝水。
zh: 医生一看我的嗓子，就说我是上火了，让我多喝水。
py: yī shēng yī kàn wǒ de sǎng zi jiù shuō wǒ shì shàng huǒ le ràng wǒ duō hē shuǐ
en: As soon as the doctor looked at my throat, he said I was run down and told me to drink more water.
why: 一看…就说 shows the diagnosis came immediately after the look. 才 would say it took a long time, and 再 would make it a later step.

zh: 小王昨天发着烧加班到十点才回家。
py: xiǎo wáng zuó tiān fā zhe shāo jiā bān dào shí diǎn cái huí jiā
en: Xiao Wang worked overtime with a fever yesterday and didn't get home until ten.
why: 十点 comes before 才, which comes right before 回家. 昨天 may precede or follow 小王.

s: 这种药要连着吃三天才有用，你不能吃一次就不吃了。
s_py: zhè zhǒng yào yào lián zhe chī sān tiān cái yǒu yòng nǐ bù néng chī yī cì jiù bù chī le
zh: 这种药要连着吃三天才有用，你不能吃一次就不吃了。
py: zhè zhǒng yào yào lián zhe chī sān tiān cái yǒu yòng nǐ bù néng chī yī cì jiù bù chī le
en: You have to take this medicine for three days in a row before it works; don't stop after one dose.
why: 三天才有用 shows the effect is slow (才, no 了). 吃一次就不吃了 shows too little effort followed by 了. Both are right.

q: 这个月我___去过一次医院，身体比去年好多了。
zh: 这个月我就去过一次医院，身体比去年好多了。
py: zhè gè yuè wǒ jiù qù guo yī cì yī yuàn shēn tǐ bǐ qù nián hǎo duō le
en: This month I've only been to the hospital once; my health is much better than last year.
why: 就 plus 去过一次 means 'only once', fitting 身体好多了. 又 and 再 mean 'again', which would suggest repeated visits and clash with the good news.

q: 孩子一发烧，妈妈___着急得睡不着觉。
zh: 孩子一发烧，妈妈就着急得睡不着觉。
py: hái zi yī fā shāo mā ma jiù zháo jí de shuì bù zháo jiào
en: As soon as the child runs a fever, Mum is so worried she can't sleep.
why: 一 in the first clause needs 就 in the second, with its own subject 妈妈 in between. 才, 又 and 也 do not complete the 一…就 pattern.

q: 只有把药吃完，病___能好，不能自己停药。
zh: 只有把药吃完，病才能好，不能自己停药。
py: zhǐ yǒu bǎ yào chī wán bìng cái néng hǎo bù néng zì jǐ tíng yào
en: Only if you finish the medicine will the illness get better; you mustn't stop taking it yourself.
why: 只有 sets a necessary condition, so 才 stands before 能. 就 would say finishing is enough, and the warning 不能自己停药 stresses that it is required.

q: 你要找的那位体检医生___在二楼，上楼往左走，第一个门。
zh: 你要找的那位体检医生就在二楼，上楼往左走，第一个门。
py: nǐ yào zhǎo de nà wèi tǐ jiǎn yī shēng jiù zài èr lóu shàng lóu wǎng zuǒ zǒu dì yī gè mén
en: The doctor you're looking for is right on the second floor: go upstairs, turn left, the first door.
why: 就在 pinpoints the location and the directions follow. 也在 would say the doctor is there as well, with no earlier mention of anyone else.

s: 只要多休息，身体才会好起来。
s_py: zhǐ yào duō xiū xi shēn tǐ cái huì hǎo qǐ lái
zh: 只要多休息，身体就会好起来。
py: zhǐ yào duō xiū xi shēn tǐ jiù huì hǎo qǐ lái
en: As long as you rest more, your health will recover.
why: 只要 pairs with 就, not 才. 才 is for 只有, 'only if'.

q: 医生说这个病很难治，他吃了半年药___好。
zh: 医生说这个病很难治，他吃了半年药才好。
py: yī shēng shuō zhè ge bìng hěn nán zhì tā chī le bàn nián yào cái hǎo
en: The doctor said this illness is hard to treat; he took medicine for half a year before he got better.
why: 难治 and 半年 describe a slow, hard road, so 才 'not until'. 就 would make half a year sound quick, which clashes with the first clause.

q: 我们小区的游泳池，夏天___这一个开着，所以人特别多。
zh: 我们小区的游泳池，夏天就这一个开着，所以人特别多。
py: wǒ men xiǎo qū de yóu yǒng chí xià tiān jiù zhè yī gè kāi zhe suǒ yǐ rén tè bié duō
en: Of the pools in our neighbourhood, only this one is open in summer, which is why it is so crowded.
why: 就 right before 这一个 limits the group to one pool, which explains 人特别多. 都 would say all of them are open, and 也 'also' cannot explain the crowd.

q: 虽然外面下着大雪，孩子们吃完早饭，不到九点___跑出去堆雪人了。
zh: 虽然外面下着大雪，孩子们吃完早饭，不到九点就跑出去堆雪人了。
py: suī rán wài miàn xià zhe dà xuě hái zi men chī wán zǎo fàn bù dào jiǔ diǎn jiù pǎo chū qù duī xuě rén le
en: Although it was snowing hard, the children ran out to build a snowman before nine, right after breakfast.
why: 不到九点 is early and the clause ends in 了: 就. 才 would mean 'not until nine', which contradicts 不到九点.

src_py: tā shí diǎn dào le yī yuàn
task: Say he didn't get there until ten, using 才.
zh: 他十点才到医院。
py: tā shí diǎn cái dào yī yuàn
en: He didn't get to the hospital until ten.
why: 才 stands right before the verb and drops the 了. 十点 stays in front of 才, and the time word may also go before 他.

q: 路上全是冰，只有等雪化了，车___能开。
zh: 路上全是冰，只有等雪化了，车才能开。
py: lù shang quán shì bīng zhǐ yǒu děng xuě huà le chē cái néng kāi
en: The road is all ice; the cars can only drive once the snow has melted.
why: 只有等…才能 is the 'only after' pattern, with 才 before 能. 就 would claim driving is easy, against 路上全是冰.

q: 她___五岁，不能一个人去医院。
zh: 她才五岁，不能一个人去医院。
py: tā cái wǔ suì bù néng yī gè rén qù yī yuàn
en: She is only five and can't go to the hospital alone.
why: 才 before an age means 'only, that is young', which explains why she can't go alone. 都 would need 了 (都五岁了) and says 'already'.

s: 只有天气好，我们就去海边玩。
s_py: zhǐ yǒu tiān qì hǎo wǒ men jiù qù hǎi biān wán
zh: 只有天气好，我们才去海边玩。
py: zhǐ yǒu tiān qì hǎo wǒ men cái qù hǎi biān wán
en: We only go to the beach when the weather is good.
why: 只有 names a necessary condition and takes 才. 就 pairs with 只要 or 如果.

q: 你不吃药，病___不会好。
zh: 你不吃药，病就不会好。
py: nǐ bù chī yào bìng jiù bù huì hǎo
en: If you don't take the medicine, you won't get better.
why: If-not-A-then-B takes 就, placed after the subject 病 and before 不会. 才 would mean 'not until', which does not fit a plain consequence.

q: 他的腿伤得很重，躺了整整三个月___能下床走路，大家都很担心。

zh: 就小王一个人没来体检。
py: jiù xiǎo wáng yī gè rén méi lái tǐ jiǎn
en: Only Xiao Wang didn't come for the check-up.
why: 就 stands right before the person it limits, even before the subject. After 小王一个人 it would no longer mean 'only'.
